item.title: SPHERES — Semi-Parametric models for Human growth, Extremes and Recurrent Events in Survival analysis
item.description:
Funding: Agencia Estatal de Investigación
Reference: PID2023-153222OB-I00
Role: Co-Principal Investigator (with Manuele Leonelli)
Budget: 62,500 €
Team: 4 researchers (PhD) and 2 PhD students

Semi-parametric modelling for human growth, extremes, and recurrent events in survival analysis.

item.title: MATH4SPORTS — Mathematical Modelling for the Sports Industry
item.description:
Funding: Provincial Council of Bizkaia
Institution: BCAM
Role: Principal Investigator
Budget: 151,328.94 €
Period: June 2022 – July 2024

Promote applied mathematical research into the challenges of today’s sport, with the main focus on the health and performance of athletes.

item.title: S3M1P4R — New proposals for estimation, prediction and validation of semi-parametric models
item.description:
Funding: Agencia Estatal de Investigación
Reference: PID2020-115882RB-I00
Role: Principal Investigator
Budget: 38,115 €
Team: 4 researchers (PhD) and 3 PhD students
Period: 01/09/2021 – 31/08/2024 (extended until 27/02/2025)

New proposals for estimation, prediction and validation of semi-parametric models for the analysis of complex data, with applications in Health and Climate Change.

item.title: Basque Modeling Task Force (BMTF) — Mathematical Modelling Applied to Health
item.description:
Funding: Basque Government (COVID-19 projects)
Role: Responsible for several working packages

Multidisciplinary task force created in March 2020 to assist Basque Health managers and the Basque Government during the COVID-19 response, combining stochastic processes, statistical methods and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Mathematical Modelling Advisory Service for SMEs
item.description:
Funding: Provincial Council of Bizkaia
Institution: BCAM
Role: Coordinator of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence projects
Budget: 180,000 €

Advisory service in mathematical modelling for SMEs and startups in Bizkaia (data diagnostics and modelling support).

item.title: AFTERAM — New Contributions in Semiparametric Regression and Applications
item.description:
Funding: MINECO / Agencia Estatal de Investigación (AEI/FEDER, UE)
Reference: MTM2017-82379-R
Role: Co-Principal Investigator (with María Xosé Rodríguez-Álvarez)
Budget: 50,457 €
Team: 2 researchers (PhD) and 2 PhD students
Period: 01/01/2018 – 31/12/2020

New contributions in semiparametric regression with applications in agricultural field trials, epidemiological risk assessment and marine ecology.
